title: "Remember Where You Came From" SCA Pesah Message by Rabbi Naftali Besser
summary: Rabbi Besser discusses the order of Pesach, Matzah, and Maror in the Haggadah. He explores why Maror is placed last despite occurring first chronologically. The class encourages remembering past challenges to maintain appreciation for the gifts Hashem provides.
questions: Why are Pesach, Matzah, and Maror in that specific order in the Haggadah?
Why should we remember the Maror even after we are saved?
How does remembering past difficulties help us appreciate Hashem?
